about.title: About Me
about.bio_p1: I'm a <0>Belgian software engineering student</0> with a passion that grew from hobbyist Python coding into a professional career path. What started as solving LeetCode problems for fun led me to pursue an associate's degree at Howest, where I graduated <1>with high honors</1>.
about.bio_p2: Currently further expanding my skills with a Bachelor of Applied Computer Science specializing in software engineering, I'm balancing academic projects with personal ventures like building this website. When I'm not coding, you'll find me <0>learning Japanese N4</0>, hiking the Belgian countryside, or capturing moments through photography.
about.bio_p3: I'm actively working toward my goal of a <0>Tokyo internship in 2027</0>, with plans to relocate permanently to Chiba after graduation. I believe in blending technical precision with creative expression, whether I'm debugging code or composing the perfect picture.

p1.title: Professional Profile
p1.text: Software engineering student in my final year, with a completed programming degree and an internship behind me. I build backends in Python and C# and frontends in React, Vue and TypeScript, and I care most about the part where a system's structure decides how far it can grow. My main project is a route planning engine over 20 million map nodes, built in a hexagonal architecture. I recently delivered a bilingual production website for a client in Tokyo. Available in Japan from February 2027.
